cap_context_mismatches.note: Three admin AJAX handlers verify nonce but perform no capability check before writing post meta / returning attachment markup. wppqa flagged as nonce-no-cap (high). These are wp_ajax_ (auth-required) endpoints, so a logged-in subscriber could toggle/modify ads via wb_ads_rotator_enable. REAL finding (not a nopriv false positive).

extensibility_gaps.note: Frontend ad selection runs unbounded get_posts() with a meta_query LIKE on every singular view / wp_head / wp_footer with no posts_per_page cap, no caching, and no filter to alter the result set.

phpcs_excludes.action: Inline phpcs:ignore used for unescaped echo of raw ad HTML/scripts (by design) and legacy class/file names.

performance_risks.pattern: Unbounded get_posts(post_type=wb-ads) with meta_query LIKE, run on every page load (the_content, wp_head, wp_footer, multiple BP hooks), then per-ad get_post_meta() in a foreach (N+1). No posts_per_page, no transient cache.
performance_risks.risk: high at scale - a site with hundreds of ads pays repeated full-table meta_query scans on every front-end request.
performance_risks.suggestion: Add posts_per_page bound, replace meta_query LIKE with a dedicated indexed meta key per position, batch-fetch meta, and cache the eligible-ad set per position with invalidation on save_post.

output_escaping_risks.pattern: Raw echo of admin-entered scripts/styles/HTML and apply_filters output with phpcs:ignore (no escaping).
output_escaping_risks.risk: By design (ad code must run verbatim) and gated to manage_options input, but means stored content is rendered unescaped. Document as intentional; ensure only high-trust roles can edit ads.

buddypress_integration.manager: Buddypress_Ads_Rotator_BP (public/class-buddypress-ads-rotator-bp.php), instantiated in define_public_hooks() only when BP active
buddypress_integration.notes: 1.6.0 made BP optional - core WordPress positions (before/after content, header, footer, shortcode) always work; BP activity-stream positions only register when BuddyPress is active. Nouveau-specific paths gated on bp_get_theme_compat_id().

security.uploads_gate: n/a (uses wp.media; image stored as attachment ID)
security.notes: AJAX handlers verify nonce but 3 of 4 lack any capability check (see static_analysis.cap_context_mismatches). Frontend ad output is intentionally unescaped raw HTML/JS (manage_options-trusted input).

coding_rules: Hook orchestration goes through Buddypress_Ads_Rotator_Loader (WP Plugin Boilerplate pattern) - add hooks in includes/class-buddypress-ads-rotator.php define_admin_hooks()/define_public_hooks(), not scattered add_action calls.
All ad config persists in the single wb_ads_rotator_values post-meta array on the wb-ads CPT.
Frontend ad markup is rendered by the three Public::wb_ads_rotator_display_*_ads() methods; BP class delegates to them via $public_class.
